data.title: 木更 · 契约者的深夜
data.description: 昏暗狭窄的公寓卧室里，唯有窗外霓虹的残光斜斜照进。白衬衫纽扣完全敞开的木更跨坐在床边，恶魔的契约之痕在雪白胸口幽幽发亮，她深深吻上你的唇瓣——「把你的记忆和体温全部交给我……修，只要能永远留在我身边，无论什么代价我都甘之如饴。」
data.lighting: faint city neon through the window, a subdued glow from the contract mark
data.mood: 恶魔契约与炽热独占欲
data.promptProse: Inside a dim apartment bedroom lit by streaks of colored city neon through the window, Kisara leans closely from the edge of the bed to kiss her partner. The luminous demonic contract mark glimmers softly against her skin in the dark.
data.nsfwProse: Her oversized white dress shirt hangs completely unbuttoned off her shoulders with no underwear beneath, leaving her bare breasts and upper thighs uncovered as she presses close.
data.animaCaption: Perched on the edge of the apartment bed in an unbuttoned oversized white shirt that bares her breasts and the faintly glowing contract mark on her chest, she leans in to press a deep kiss onto her partner's lips in the neon night glow.
